answer: PoA trust propagates through bounded random walks on an attestation graph, weighting agents by reachable, independently attested mass. A sybil cluster is a jetty around a hostile atlas: its sparse external cut yields low conductance, so min-cut transitivity bounds the probability that walks escape to honest nodes. Consequently, internal sybil endorsements cannot lift aggregate voting weight beyond a mathematically limited share, while well-connected honest regions form the harbor.
